0.en: Jack's fingers raced over the keyboard.
0.id: Jari-jari Jack berpacu di atas papan ketik.

4.en: Come on. Give me manual control!

6.en: Sarah moved to the secondary console.

7.en: I'll try to interrupt the calculation.

8.id: Jack mengangguk ke arah konsol Sarah.

10.en: Her fingers moved quickly across the controls.
10.id: Jari-jarinya bergerak cepat di atas panel kendali.

14.en: Sarah tried the command a second time.
14.id: Sarah mencoba perintah itu untuk kedua kalinya.

16.en: The building shook hard enough that Sarah caught herself against the console. Jack immediately grabbed her arm.
16.id: Gedung itu berguncang begitu keras sampai Sarah harus berpegangan pada konsol. Jack langsung menyambar lengannya.

18.en: Sarah steadied herself against the console.
18.id: Sarah menyeimbangkan badannya dengan bertumpu pada konsol.

20.en: Jack kept hold of her arm.

24.en: Another vibration rolled through the floor. The muted warning tones at the consoles cut off one by one. Jack's screen flashed.
24.id: Getaran lain menjalar di lantai. Satu per satu, nada peringatan yang teredam di konsol-konsol berhenti. Layar Jack berkedip.

31.en: Jack finally looked away from the screen.
31.id: Jack akhirnya mengalihkan pandangan dari layar.

33.en: Sarah pointed at the locked value.
33.id: Sarah menunjuk nilai yang terkunci itu.

35.en: Before he could respond, every light in the laboratory turned white.
35.id: Sebelum Jack sempat menjawab, semua lampu di laboratorium berubah putih.

38.en: The sound vanished. It didn't fade or become muffled. It simply ceased to exist.
38.id: Suara lenyap. Bukan memudar, bukan pula teredam. Suara itu begitu saja tidak ada lagi.

39.en: Jack could see Sarah shouting, but he couldn't hear her. The laboratory seemed to stretch around them, the walls impossibly far away for a fraction of a second and then impossibly close. His stomach dropped as light bent around Sarah's body.
39.id: Jack bisa melihat Sarah berteriak, tetapi ia tidak bisa mendengarnya. Laboratorium itu seakan meregang di sekeliling mereka; selama sepersekian detik dinding-dindingnya terasa jauh tak masuk akal, lalu dekat tak masuk akal. Perutnya serasa anjlok ketika cahaya melengkung di sekitar tubuh Sarah.

40.en: Jack tightened his grip on her hand.
40.id: Jack mempererat genggamannya pada tangan Sarah.

41.en: The floor seemed to disappear beneath his feet.
41.id: Lantai seakan lenyap dari bawah kakinya.

43.en: Sound returned all at once as Jack hit the floor and Sarah landed beside him. Somewhere inside the array chamber, metal rang once and went still.
43.id: Suara kembali seketika, bersamaan dengan Jack yang terempas ke lantai dan Sarah yang jatuh di sampingnya. Di suatu tempat di dalam ruang Array, logam berdenting sekali, lalu senyap.

46.id: Sarah mendorong tubuhnya hingga terduduk tegak.

47.en: I'm here. I don't think so.

50.en: Sarah pressed a hand against her stomach.
50.id: Sarah menekankan sebelah tangan ke perutnya.

54.en: She closed her eyes, waited, and then smiled.
54.id: Sarah memejamkan mata, menunggu, lalu tersenyum.

56.en: Jack released the breath he had been holding.
56.id: Jack mengembuskan napas yang sedari tadi ditahannya.

60.en: The laboratory settled into an unsettling silence. Jack slowly stood and looked around. Nothing appeared different. The consoles were intact, the TOMBS Array had stopped, and even the emergency lighting had returned to normal.
60.id: Laboratorium itu lalu tenggelam dalam keheningan yang mencekam. Jack perlahan berdiri dan memandang sekeliling. Tidak ada yang tampak berbeda. Konsol-konsol masih utuh, Array TOMBS sudah berhenti, bahkan lampu darurat pun sudah kembali normal.

61.en: Sarah got to her feet beside him and looked around.
61.id: Sarah bangkit berdiri di sampingnya dan memandang sekeliling.

63.en: Jack glanced back at the main console. The display had gone dark except for a single status light. He crossed the room and touched the controls.
63.id: Jack menoleh ke konsol utama. Layarnya sudah gelap, kecuali satu lampu status. Ia menyeberangi ruangan dan menyentuh panel kendalinya.

65.en: Sarah followed more carefully, one hand resting beneath her stomach.
65.id: Sarah menyusul dengan lebih hati-hati, sebelah tangannya menyangga bagian bawah perutnya.

67.en: Jack tried the controls again. He hated how quickly the answer came.
67.id: Jack mencoba panel kendali itu sekali lagi. Ia benci betapa cepat jawabannya datang.

69.en: Sarah looked toward the chamber window.
69.id: Sarah memandang ke arah jendela ruang Array.

71.en: Jack pulled up the local sensor grid. Temperature, pressure, and atmosphere all looked normal. Structural sensors showed no collapse. The laboratory had power. The floor was still beneath them. On paper, almost nothing had happened.
71.id: Jack membuka jaringan sensor lokal. Suhu, tekanan, dan atmosfer semuanya tampak normal. Sensor struktural tidak menunjukkan adanya keruntuhan. Laboratorium masih berlistrik. Lantai masih ada di bawah kaki mereka. Di atas kertas, nyaris tidak terjadi apa-apa.

72.en: That bothered him more than a room full of broken equipment would have.
72.id: Justru itu yang lebih mengusiknya daripada ruangan penuh peralatan yang rusak.

73.en: Sarah watched him move through the readings.
73.id: Sarah memperhatikannya menelusuri hasil pembacaan satu per satu.

76.en: Everything says we're fine. Which means something is very wrong.
76.id: Semuanya bilang kita baik-baik saja. Artinya, ada yang sangat tidak beres.

77.en: Jack looked through the chamber window.
77.id: Jack memandang lewat jendela ruang Array.

79.en: His wrist terminal chirped with an incoming call from island utility control. Jack answered, and Lena's voice burst through it.
79.id: Terminal pergelangannya berbunyi pendek: panggilan masuk dari kendali utilitas pulau. Jack menjawab, dan suara Lena langsung menyembur keluar.

85.en: Jack brought up the building status.

87.en: Lena checked the system report from the utility station.
87.id: Lena memeriksa laporan sistem dari stasiun utilitas.

88.en: We've got power. Most systems are responding, but communications are down.
88.id: Listrik ada. Sebagian besar sistem merespons, tapi komunikasi putus.

91.en: External. We can't reach anything beyond the settlement.
91.id: Eksternal. Kita tidak bisa menghubungi apa pun di luar permukiman.

98.en: Behind him, Sarah had walked toward a window.
98.id: Di belakangnya, Sarah sudah berjalan ke dekat sebuah jendela.

100.en: Jack kept his attention on the terminal.
100.id: Perhatian Jack tetap tertuju pada terminalnya.

102.en: Sarah was still at the window.
102.id: Sarah masih berdiri di dekat jendela.

108.en: Something in her voice made him lower his wrist. Sarah stood motionless at the window.
108.id: Ada sesuatu dalam suara Sarah yang membuat Jack menurunkan pergelangan tangannya. Sarah berdiri mematung di depan jendela.

109.en: Jack walked over and stopped beside her.
109.id: Jack menghampirinya dan berhenti di sampingnya.

113.en: For several seconds, his mind refused to understand what he was seeing. The street was there. The building across from them was there. Streetlights still glowed, and a parked utility vehicle sat exactly where it had been.
113.id: Selama beberapa detik, pikirannya menolak memahami apa yang ia lihat. Jalan itu masih ada. Gedung di seberang mereka masih ada. Lampu-lampu jalan masih menyala, dan sebuah kendaraan utilitas masih terparkir persis di tempatnya semula.

114.en: Everything inside the settlement looked normal.
114.id: Segala sesuatu di dalam permukiman tampak normal.

115.en: Beyond it, the world was wrong.

116.en: Jack stepped closer to the glass.

118.en: The hills beyond the research district were gone. In their place stood enormous shapes reaching into the darkness.
118.id: Perbukitan di balik distrik riset sudah lenyap. Sebagai gantinya, berdiri bentuk-bentuk raksasa yang menjulang ke dalam kegelapan.

119.en: Sarah pointed toward the edge of the settlement.
119.id: Sarah menunjuk ke arah tepi permukiman.

121.en: Jack stared at a blade rising beyond the developed area. It wasn't inches high or even feet high from where they stood. It towered above buildings. Another stood beside it, then another, until thousands disappeared into the night like a forest.
121.id: Jack menatap sehelai daun rumput yang menjulang di balik area terbangun. Dari tempat mereka berdiri, tingginya bukan lagi hitungan inci, bahkan bukan hitungan kaki. Helai itu menjulang melampaui gedung-gedung. Di sebelahnya berdiri satu helai lagi, lalu satu lagi, hingga ribuan helai menghilang ke dalam malam seperti hutan.

122.en: Jack backed away from the window.

126.en: He rushed to the console and opened the camera controls.
126.id: Jack bergegas ke konsol dan membuka kendali kamera.

128.en: Jack opened the settlement's perimeter feeds. Camera One showed the northern edge buried beneath towering grass. Camera Two showed the western road ending at an enormous wall of earth and vegetation. Camera Three showed a tree Jack had walked past hundreds of times.
128.id: Jack membuka tayangan kamera perimeter permukiman. Kamera Satu menampilkan tepi utara yang terkubur di bawah rumput yang menjulang. Kamera Dua menampilkan jalan barat yang berujung pada dinding raksasa dari tanah dan tetumbuhan. Kamera Tiga menampilkan sebatang pohon yang sudah ratusan kali Jack lewati.

129.en: Now the camera couldn't fit its trunk on the screen.
129.id: Kini batangnya bahkan tidak muat di layar kamera itu.

130.en: Jack switched the feed to a camera mounted higher on the communications building and rotated it toward the coastline. The camera moved normally, but the horizon never appeared. Grass stems, leaves, and dark walls of soil filled the view in every direction.
130.id: Jack mengalihkan tayangan ke kamera yang terpasang lebih tinggi di gedung komunikasi, lalu memutarnya ke arah garis pantai. Kamera itu bergerak normal, tetapi cakrawala tak pernah muncul. Batang-batang rumput, dedaunan, dan dinding tanah yang gelap memenuhi pandangan ke segala arah.

131.en: Sarah leaned closer to the screen.

134.en: She looked at him, then back at the image.
134.id: Sarah menatapnya, lalu kembali memandangi gambar itu.

135.en: Jack changed cameras again. A security light near the southern boundary illuminated what looked like a curved glass wall. For a moment he could not place it. Then a bead of water slid down the surface, trembling in the light.
135.id: Jack berganti kamera lagi. Sebuah lampu keamanan di dekat batas selatan menerangi sesuatu yang tampak seperti dinding kaca melengkung. Sesaat ia tidak bisa mengenalinya. Lalu setitik air meluncur turun di permukaannya, bergetar dalam cahaya.

136.en: Sarah's voice dropped to a whisper.

138.en: Jack said nothing. The droplet was enormous compared with the nearby road.
138.id: Jack tidak berkata apa-apa. Tetesan itu begitu besar dibandingkan jalan di dekatnya.

139.en: A faint vibration passed through the building. It was softer than the TOMBS Array had been, but deeper, almost like distant thunder. Both of them froze.
139.id: Getaran samar merambat melewati gedung. Getaran itu lebih halus daripada getaran Array TOMBS tadi, tetapi lebih dalam, hampir seperti guntur di kejauhan. Keduanya membeku.

143.en: The vibration came again, then faded into the night.
143.id: Getaran itu datang lagi, lalu memudar ke dalam malam.

146.en: Jack did not answer. He was no longer certain he wanted to know.
146.id: Jack tidak menjawab. Ia tidak lagi yakin ingin tahu.

147.en: Sarah came up beside him and stared at the feeds.
147.id: Sarah mendekat ke sampingnya dan menatap tayangan-tayangan kamera itu.

149.en: Jack opened the TOMBS event log. One final record remained.
149.id: Jack membuka log peristiwa TOMBS. Tinggal satu catatan terakhir.

151.en: Below it was the scale factor.

155.en: The computer calmly displayed what neither of them was ready to say. The island hadn't grown. The wilderness hadn't changed. The ocean hadn't changed. The rest of the world was exactly the same size it had been ten minutes ago.
155.id: Komputer itu dengan tenang menampilkan apa yang belum sanggup mereka ucapkan. Pulau itu tidak membesar. Alam liar tidak berubah. Lautan tidak berubah. Seluruh dunia lainnya masih berukuran persis sama seperti sepuluh menit yang lalu.

157.en: Jack opened the boundary record and overlaid it on the settlement map. The line traced the research district, housing blocks, medical center, workshops, utilities, and the streets connecting them. It stopped almost perfectly where the developed town gave way to untouched island.
157.id: Jack membuka catatan batas dan menumpangkannya di atas peta permukiman. Garis itu menelusuri distrik riset, blok-blok perumahan, pusat medis, bengkel-bengkel, fasilitas utilitas, dan jalan-jalan yang menghubungkan semuanya. Garis itu berhenti nyaris sempurna tepat di tempat kota yang terbangun berakhir dan pulau yang belum terjamah dimulai.

161.id: Semua orang di dalam batas itu.

166.en: Sarah looked down at her stomach and then toward the darkened town beyond the glass.
166.id: Sarah menunduk menatap perutnya, lalu memandang kota yang gelap di balik kaca.

168.en: Jack nodded once. The number felt different now. It was no longer a population statistic in a planning report. It was every sleeping family, every night-shift technician, every child, every patient, and every person who would wake to a world that no longer fit them.
168.id: Jack mengangguk sekali. Angka itu kini terasa lain. Angka itu bukan lagi statistik populasi dalam laporan perencanaan. Angka itu adalah setiap keluarga yang sedang terlelap, setiap teknisi sif malam, setiap anak, setiap pasien, dan setiap orang yang akan terbangun di dunia yang tak lagi sepadan dengan ukuran mereka.

169.en: Jack looked through the window again at the impossible forest beyond the streetlights. Five hundred people, their homes, laboratories, vehicles, and everything else inside the TOMBS boundary had been caught in the same event.
169.id: Jack kembali memandang lewat jendela, ke arah hutan mustahil di balik lampu-lampu jalan. Lima ratus orang, rumah mereka, laboratorium, kendaraan, dan segala hal lain di dalam batas TOMBS telah terseret dalam peristiwa yang sama.

172.en: He squeezed her fingers. For the first time since the alarm sounded, he had no answer.
172.id: Jack meremas jemari Sarah. Untuk pertama kalinya sejak alarm berbunyi, ia tidak punya jawaban.
